Column order is EXACT in every row: 1 single clenched warrior GAUNTLET weapon, diagonal presentation; 2 warrior PLATE CHEST ARMOR with broad angular metal shoulder plates and a short waist, no head/body/legs; 3 long slim mage STAFF weapon shown diagonally, entire staff visible; 4 mage CLOTH ROBE, distinctly tall hooded draped cloth silhouette with long flowing sleeves and hem, no plate cuirass or large hard shoulder armor, no person wearing it. Row 1 set A, named Travel Lantern (旅灯, do not write name): weathered leather and dull steel, tiny warm lantern-glass inset, practical novice design. Gauntlet has leather hand plates; chest armor has plain iron breastplate over leather and modest shoulders; staff is straight dark wood with a small enclosed lantern-glass finial; robe is muted ivory/grey cloth with a simple hood, leather belt and one small warm glass clasp.

Row 3 set C, named Dusk Bronze (暮铜, do not write name): visibly superior refinement and strength to B, but still common, not legendary. Dark bronze, warm aged copper seams, compact engraved details and well made reinforced edges. Gauntlet has layered bronze knuckles and a compact amber-grey inset; chest armor has sculpted bronze breastplate and three restrained shoulder layers; staff has a graceful bronze cage finial around a small smoky crystal; robe is charcoal cream cloth with woven bronze edging, layered hood, long narrow hanging cloth panels and a bronze clasp.
